description: Read what is known about how one customer buys: price sensitivity set against their segment's learned elasticity, negotiation history and outcomes, their buyer agents and spend policies, the price experiments they were in, the price changes they saw and the team's notes. Answers 404 (not released) until the customer Overview and Intel release is on for your workspace. Needs a Last Price credential with billing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_customer_intel
